caption: The drawing depicts a single brown leather spur strap attached to a metal spur. The spur strap, positioned on the left side of the image, has a basket-weave pattern and a rounded end. The metal spur, connected to the strap, is mostly silver-gray in color with alternating light and dark chevron or zigzag patterns along its band. The spur features a large, circular silver button like a concho where the band meets the heel. Extending from the band is a neck that ends in a multi-pointed rowel, also colored gray. The objects are centered against a plain, off-white background. The artist’s signature, "Arthur E. Reynolds," appears below and to the right of the objects.
title: Spur
